entity.title: SyncOperation
entity.description: A single execution of the synchronization process.

rules.body: IS a single execution of the synchronization process.
HAS a UUID.
HAS a trigger type which MUST be one of: "push", "manual", "schedule".
HAS a UTC timestamp.
HAS a status which MUST be one of: "pending", "running", "completed", "failed".
MUST produce one or more SyncPullRequests for out-of-date repositories.
MAY operate in dry-run mode where no PRs are created or updated.
MUST record results in the DeploymentState.
MUST record results in the DeploymentState, except in dry-run mode, which MUST NOT write it.
HAS a status which MUST be one of: "completed", "failed".

entity.title: SyncPullRequest
entity.description: A pull request created in a target repository to deliver a template update.

rules.body: IS a pull request created in a target repository to deliver a template update.
MUST use a branch name in the format `steerspec-sync/<template-id>/<version>`.
The PR body MUST include: previous version, new version, changelog, and diff link.
MUST be labeled with a configurable label (default: `steerspec-sync`) when it is created.
MUST update an existing open PR for the same template rather than creating a duplicate.
MUST close stale version PRs for the same template when a newer version PR is created.
MUST close stale version PRs for the same template when a newer version PR is created (configurable via `close-stale-prs`).

MUST use a branch name in the format `steerspec-sync/<template-id>/<version>` when `pr-grouping` is "template", and `steerspec-sync/repo/<hash>` when it is "repo", where `<hash>` is the first 8 lowercase hex characters of the Blake3 hash of the UTF-8 bytes of the `<template-id>@<version>` entries of the templates the PR carries, sorted bytewise and joined by a single newline (U+000A) with no trailing newline.
MUST update an existing open PR on the same branch rather than creating a duplicate.

When `close-stale-prs` is true, opening or updating a sync PR MUST close the other open sync PRs in that repository that it replaces: with `pr-grouping` "template", those for the same template and every PR on a `steerspec-sync/repo/` branch; with "repo", every other PR on a `steerspec-sync/repo/` branch and those for a template it carries.

With `pr-grouping` "repo", each sync run that opens or updates a SyncPullRequest MUST add exactly one commit to it containing every template that is out of date for its repository and renders without error, and the SyncPullRequest body MUST have one section per template it carries with the fields of SYNCPR-003.

notes.content: This follows the Dependabot pattern of updating PRs in place to avoid PR flooding.
